notes.title: Major Update v1.1: Blessings of the Five (Plus a Sale!)
notes.content:
Today marks the first major content update for [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i]! Besides the usual bug fixes and polish, we've got some significant improvements tailored to address player feedback. Since much of our early criticism has centered around the game's difficulty, we asked each of the High Priests of Flaustria to help by giving our players a blessing.

In short, this update adds:
[list]
[*] Time Travel
[*] New Challenges
[*] Friendlier Metagame Progression
[*] Bug Fixes
[*] Our First Sale -  [b]25% off, this week only![/b]
[*] ICYMI, we're Steam Deck Verified!
[/list]

[h2]Accolades Trailer[/h2]
Before we get into the details, here's a new trailer to share what games media thinks of AtB so far:

[previewyoutube=LagS3hOPoxU;full][/previewyoutube]
Now let's dive further into the update!  To explain more, here are the High Priests of Flaustria.

[h2]Time Travel[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/a70361bda1afd721477e3311d539335fc346a306.png[/img]

Even though we tried to make failure fun and rewarding, it's still human nature to want to succeed, and understandable to tilt when plans go awry. That's why we're adding a Restart Day option to the System Menu. When your run turns to ruin due to wheel of fortune or human flaw, you can now make a choice whether to ride it out or turn back time to give it a fresh try.

Details:
[list]
[*] The Restart Day button is unlocked when you have completed two or more runs. The Lion will tell you about it in the Void.
[*] To access the button, open the in-game System Menu (the gear at the right of the top HUD bar). Restart Day will appear on the left side if you've met the conditions above.
[*] The button will reset to the start of the current day, undoing everything that has happened since (including any unlocks or other metagame changes). Be aware that the space launch, parade, and final judgment all count as one day, so restarting anytime during that sequence will return to the morning before the launch.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/3e1143b5fb3cb76cfaab13ca7e8ea6477d68e2c9.png[/img]

This is basically institutionalized save scumming, because we the devs don't have any problem with save scumming. We encourage you to explore and find the game's many weird avenues for failing forward, but at the same time, if you're invested in a certain outcome we don't want you to feel like you've wasted an hour or more. (That true final mission can be pretty tough, after all.)

[h2]New Challenges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/1c73780b790dbce4a8fdaf39c22bbe39277be958.png[/img]

Five new Challenges are now available in the postgame store! We felt that there wasn't quite enough variety in challenges originally, so players too often felt obligated to pick ones that were repetitive or upsetting. This new batch offers a pleasant assortment ranging from silly changes to straightforward difficulty spikes to real hardcore sicko stuff.

[h3]New Challenge Descriptions[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Blind Date:[/b] Astronauts start with none of their traits revealed
[*] [b]Nabobs of Negativity:[/b] Televised judges have a higher difficulty.
[*] [b]Same Name Game:[/b] All astronauts have the same name, which cannot be changed
[*] [b]Super Accountant Mode:[/b] The HUD does not track your resources; you must do so manually.
[*] [b]Alternative Schooling:[/b] You cannot train astronauts.
[/list]

[h2]Friendlier Metagame Progression[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/d45d40d386846494f98daf869aedeb50537c8c5e.png[/img]

Every mission in AtB is built to be replayable, but we don't ever want players to feel like they're "grinding" to unlock new options or progress the metagame story. To that end, this patch makes it significantly easier to reach new missions, Challenges, and other metagame unlocks.

[list]
[*] A successful space launch is no longer required to unlock the next mission or earn a Nice Bird stamp. Instead, you just need to complete your mission. In other words, any run where you make it past Day 10 will unlock the next mission or challenge set.
[*] Rebalanced prices for all postgame unlockables to be lower, so playthroughs can have more variety.
[*] Also rebalanced postgame prices so that the things we recommend you unlock first tend to be cheaper than the weirder or more expert options.
[/list]
That should make it easier to discover Flaustria's mysteries and track down that elusive True Ending!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/1e497900c60af8e512d215891af4104d5b065a46.png[/img]

What patch would be complete without a panoply of fixes and miscellaneous improvements? Details follow:

[h3]Parade Pacing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made a few changes to make parades more concise and less repetitive
[*] Cut skill tests for astronauts, outside special circumstances
[*] Cut down on the amount of discussion about each astronaut: now only mentions traits or minor events if there isn't anything more interesting to talk about
[*] High Priest cars now only stop if you have a positive or negative relationship with them
[/list]
[h3]Menu Functionality[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing system menu to be unopenable with mapestry open
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes hovering over the mission progress HUD with the mouse could instead highlight the System Menu button
[*] Fixed some rare circumstances where System Menu would not recognize input
[*] Added title to System Menu
[/list]
[h3]Readability / Ease of Understanding[/h3]
[list]
[*] When an event asks you to choose an astronaut for a skill test, the relevant stat now appears on each astronaut's selection bubble
[*] When an event asks you to choose an astronaut for a test of multiple skills, all the skills will now be highlighted instead of just one
[*] Instead of saying "0 days remaining" or "1 day remaining," mission UI now says "today" or "tomorrow" to be more clear
[*] Changed warning about replaying "Earning Your Wings" to be more clear that succeeding at its space launch is super hard and you should probably move onto other missions instead
[/list]
[h3]Small Visual Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] In "Earning Your Wings," fixed Vladagar comedian's face appearing as blank/uninitialized at first in the parade
[*] Repositioned flowers during mission intros and tutorials to fit onscreen
[*] Changed lock icon on mission/uniform select screens to fit fully in the window
[*] Darkened unrevealed mapestry icons to make it more mysterious what they will be
[*] Moved Inside-Track upwards to be better framed in the Shop
[*] Changed camera position of Astronauts menu to make spreadsheet easier to read
[/list]

[h2]Limited Time Sale[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/e9291f235af978bb4fee4ea61dbb6ed8b0b59d98.png[/img]

That's right, High Priest Inside-Track! For the next week (October 17th to October 24th), [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] will be on sale for [b]25% off[/b]! That's Five percent off for each of The Five, slashing our price to a lowest-ever [b]$11.25 USD[/b]. 

Don't delay! Get your hands on the new and improved [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] now, before this deal careens into an asteroid and gets incinerated!

[h2]Steam Deck Verified![/h2]

We're also thrilled to share the news that [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] has been Steam Deck Verified! If you have a Steam Deck, we think it just might be the best way to play it. See our previous patch notes for some optimizations we made for playing on the go.

---

That's all for Update 1.1! As always, we appreciate your interest and support. If you find bugs or other issues, or if you just want to discuss the game, please drop by our Discord.

Best,
Mike and the UHM team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Today marks our first postrelease patch!  We've got more updates coming soon, but here are a few we wanted to put out there first. The main focus is creating a better experience on Steam Deck and other similar setups.

[b]Small Screen Readability[/b]
Adjusted all size of all onscreen text for readability at smaller screen sizes. As a result, astronaut info and tooltips have a different shape. In addition, some trait descriptions have been edited for brevity (with nothing of consequence lost).

[b]Input[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworded some tutorial messages to be more input-neutral
[*]Disabled WASD key movement to fix some input bugs. I'm 99% sure nobody was using that, but let us know in Discord if you were.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes - "Earning Your Wings" Mission[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed second astronaut's stats appearing inaccurately on first day
[*]Fixed second astronaut losing training when gaining a personality
[*]Fixed chance of High Priests demanding irrelevant promises
[*]Fixed music bug during first day of launch week
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes - Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Added missing path in Prestige Drama mapestry
[*]Fixed Prestige Drama logic bug where supporting Clappy wouldn't let you run a PSA
[*]Fixed some typos
[/list]

We've been listening to your feedback, and we have some more plans for improvements on the horizon. For more bug reports or feature requests, feel free to visit our [url=https://discord.gg/zbDusCRmHw]Discord[/url] server. Thanks for playing [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i]!

notes.title: Visual Novel Fest Demo!
notes.content:
From August 7-14th, [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] is part of Steam's Visual Novel Fest!  To celebrate, we're offering a special limited-time demo including two missions.

The featured mission "Prestige Drama" challenges you to shape the nation’s perception of space by meddling in a popular TV show. Will you turn the show into space race propaganda, lead a coup against the production, or influence a classy drama to become a lurid romance? The choice is up to you. "Prestige Drama" comes replete with a panoply of never-before-seen polish and usability features that make it a whole new experience from its previous public appearance at LudoNarraCon 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40931597/f8126ba721a3decb09051b82141b78a2f9c66be7.png[/img]

Sure, [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] isn’t your typical visual novel. But for fans of decision-based narratives, It offers surreally comedic consequences, a moral laboratory of perilous responsibility, and roguelite missions that are never the same twice. Guide procedurally generated astronauts through a web of scandals, challenges, and space-shatteringly meaningful choices. Turn incompetent recruits into national heroes by any means necessary, or your bosses will see you dead in a ditch.

On August 15th, this demo will no longer be available... but the full game will be released!  Please consider wishlisting if you'd like to support strange and original games that are trying to evolve the visual novel into something new.

Enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Astronaut: The Best Launching August 15th!
notes.content:
[i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] is releasing on [b]August 15th, 2023[/b], available for $14.99 USD!  After eight years of hard work, we can't wait for you to see all the surprises the full release has in store. Check out our announcement trailer below for a sample.

[previewyoutube=EbkPomZBxyE;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're intrigued we would greatly appreciate your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239950/Astronaut_The_Best/]wishlist[/url] and your help spreading the word! 

[h3]About Astronaut: The Best[/h3]

[i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] is an occult management adventure about running a space academy using lies, witchcraft, and/or hard work. Your astronauts aren't just stats: they're incompetent screwups. You must guide procedurally misfit recruits through a roguelite web of scandals, challenges, and space-shatteringly meaningful choices. Turn them into national heroes by any means necessary, or your bosses will see you dead in a ditch. 

Learn more on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239950/Astronaut_The_Best/]Steam page[/url]!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible!
notes.content:
[i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] is fully playable on [b]Steam Deck[/b]!  

After extensive QA and player feedback, we are confident that [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] not only meets all of Valve's criteria for Steam Deck verification, but runs smoothly throughout the entire gameplay experience. Our team thinks that Steam Deck might just be the best way to play [i]AtB[/i]!

We are awaiting a review from Valve to receive the official Steam Deck verification badge, but this currently has no timetable. So we encourage you to try it out now!

Thanks for your interest in [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i]!  We hope you enjoy playing it on whatever platform you choose, and as always, we would be happy to hear about any issues you encounter.

Best,
Mike and the Universal Happymaker team

notes.title: LudoNarraCon Exclusive Demo: New Mission!
notes.content:
The Flaustrian Royal Space Academy has encountered its most deadly threat yet: [i]Spacewolves[/i]. 

Needless to say, that is the name of TV's most popular prestige drama, which portrays space exploration as a senseless danger. With every episode that airs, the people of Flaustria turn more and more against your mission to visit space. And since your rocket is powered by the belief of the people, that's a serious issue.

From May 4-11th, visit [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i]'s Steam page to download an exclusive demo of our new mission "Prestige Drama."  This demo is our exhibit in LudoNarraCon 2023, so you can imagine as you play it that you are situated at a tactfully decorated booth in a lavish expo hall full of wonders.

The demo includes our tutorial mission "Earning Your Wings" along with "Prestige Drama." In the full game, you'll be able to actually go to space, along with unlocking more missions and magic to explore through a multiverse-spanning roguelite metagame.  Please remember to wishlist [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i] to learn more about our release and future demos!

notes.title: A Very Ludonarrative Conversation w/ Prof. Sean Bouchard
notes.content:
When exhibiting at LudoNarraCon, we wanted to contribute with a meaningful discussion about the intersection of game design and narrative. To do it properly, we've enlisted the help of [b]Sean Bouchard[/b], Professor of Game Design at USC and cohost of Mostly Walking.  

Join us for a dive into the game design of [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i], and learn about the process and inspirations behind its unique procedural narrative!

notes.title: Special Guest Playthrough w/ Alex Beachum of Mobius Digital
notes.content: We're delighted and honored to host [b]Alex Beachum[/b], creative director of the seminal space game [i]Outer Wilds[/i]!  Join us as he talks with [i]Astronaut: The Best[/i]'s designers Mike Sennott and David Mershon while sampling the strange delights of AtB's LudoNarraCon demo. Some discussions about game design are likely to result alongside the many other tangents!

notes.title: AtB Developer Playthrough and Q&A
notes.content:
What even is Astronaut The Best?  The designers of AtB give an inside look at the new LudoNarraCon-exclusive mission, joined by moderator Jules Engel.

Take a look before trying the LNC demo, to know what you're getting into.  Or tune in after playing, to learn more about the development behind it - and perhaps some secrets of the full game.

We'll be restreaming this often (along with some other special events!) during LudoNarraCon from May 4-8th, so stop by anytime during the show.  But during the specified time, we'll be in the chat answering viewer questions, so especially tune in then!
